scope: pve-sbx API and backup completion; platform=pve host metrics have no cluster label
captureLimits: Daily bounded recording only; no historical inference samples used. Original unscoped captured expressions are preserved below. Name-only guest measurements require unambiguous recorded inventory. No current-state assertion derives from repository guest definitions.

guestInfo.meaning: Non-template identity. Recorded identity has name/node/type only; never invent VMID or tags.

guestUp.meaning: Observed guest state, not desired state.
guestUp.capturedExpression: max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_up) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

guestCpu.meaning: Reported CPU ratio, percent. No idle inference when absent.
guestCpu.capturedExpression: 100 * max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

guestMemory.meaning: Guest memory used / configured. Capture clamps at 100%; live query preserves reported ratio.
guestMemory.capturedExpression: clamp_max(100 * max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})) / max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})), 100)

guestUptime.meaning: Reported uptime at window end, not a lifecycle event history.
guestUptime.capturedExpression: max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_uptime_seconds) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

guestOnboot.meaning: Boot policy only; not desired current runtime state.

guestDiskSize.meaning: Allocated guest disk capacity, not VM filesystem occupancy.

guestNotBackedUp.meaning: One means excluded from every backup job. Missing series alone establishes nothing.

backupInventory.meaning: Unfilled omission inventory total. Only live zero corroborates inclusion of inventoried guests; the recorded vector(0) total is deliberately unused.

quorum.meaning: Reported quorum flag. Capture omits cluster label; no hard-coded node or guest health inference.

nodeUp.meaning: PVE API node status; separate from host collector status.

pools.meaning: Pool occupancy by node/storage. Shared NFS pools appear once per storage name; two shares may expose the same backing capacity and must not be added.
pools.capturedExpression: sort_desc(100 * max by (node, storage) (label_mismatch(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * on (id) group_left(storage, node, plugintype) max by (id, storage, node, plugintype) (pve_storage_info), "plugintype", "nfs")) or label_set(100 * max by (storage) (label_match(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * on (id) group_left(storage, node, plugintype) max by (id, storage, node, plugintype) (pve_storage_info), "plugintype", "nfs")), "node", "shared"))

hostInfo.meaning: Host inventory seen over 24h; does not establish current collection or API availability.

hostCpu.meaning: Host CPU busy percent over 5m. Host-pushed series have no cluster label.

hostMemory.meaning: Host memory occupied, separately from guest allocations.
hostMemory.capturedExpression: 100 * (1 - max by (instance, platform) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job=~"node-exporter|(pve|spark|synology|pi)-node",platform!=""}) / max by (instance, platform) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job=~"node-exporter|(pve|spark|synology|pi)-node",platform!=""}))

hostUp.meaning: Host node-exporter collection status, not PVE quorum or API status.

hostCpuHistory.meaning: Native host CPU history; recording contains other platforms and consumers must filter platform=pve.

hostAge.meaning: Seconds since host scrape status observation.

guestCpuHistory.meaning: Native per-guest ratio history; no captured range available.

guestMemoryHistory.meaning: Native per-guest bytes history; no captured range available.

hostMemoryHistory.meaning: Available host memory bytes. Not recorded.

backupCompletion.meaning: Latest completion timestamps by node, job and outcome over 48h. Sparse push samples require lookback. No completion recording exists; empty never means success.

backupCompletionHistory.meaning: Rolling latest completion timestamps over 48h, not job counts or a complete ledger. No recording.
